# GR Scale

> GR Scale sets up AI agents for local service businesses so they never lose a customer to a missed call: a website with online booking, missed-call text-back, Google review requests and a 24/7 AI receptionist. Based in Tampa, Florida. Founded by Gio Rivera. Free demo first; live within 48 hours after approval.

## The agents

- Website + Online Booking — $297 setup + $97/mo
- Missed-Call Text-Back — $97/mo (every missed call gets a text with the booking link in seconds)
- Review Getter — $67/mo (Google review requests by text after each visit)
- AI Receptionist — $297 setup + $297/mo (answers calls 24/7, always says it is an AI assistant)

## Front Desk Bundle

- Website + booking, missed-call text-back and Review Getter
- $297 setup + $197/mo; founding price $147/mo for the first 5 businesses
- Month to month, cancel anytime with 14 days notice

## Who it's for

Barbershops, salons, HVAC, lawn care, auto detailers and other local service businesses in Tampa Bay (Tampa, Lutz, Carrollwood, Temple Terrace, Brandon, Wesley Chapel).

## Proof of work

- meloair.net — Melo Air, HVAC (Tampa, FL)
- lexthebarber.com — Lex The Barber (Orlando, FL)
